exercises.name: Marathon Builder
exercises.scheme: 1 long run — push maximum distance each cycle. Track distance and pace.

exercises.name: Weighted Chin-Ups
exercises.scheme: 1 warm-up, 4× Power Waves (weighted), 1 close-set max reps

exercises.name: Kneeling Plate Woodchop
exercises.scheme: 3×8 each side — high to low, stay tall

exercises.name: Tempo Run
exercises.scheme: Track distance and pace. Beat last Marathon Builder pace.

exercises.name: 1 Mile
exercises.scheme: 1 mile, fast as possible. Track pace.

exercises.name: Plate Around-the-World
exercises.scheme: 2×6–8 each direction — plate circles the torso

exercises.name: Flush Cardio
exercises.scheme: Flush legs with bike or light run

sessions.notes: Got sore quickly - so volume lifts after power waves are pretty weak - beat those next time
First mile in a long time, legs sore and back hurt, but pace felt easier than I was expecting. Hips might be more flexible after years of deadlinfting
No bike - two softball games later to flush the legs!

EZ bar easier than DBs.
Could go heavier on inside curl / overhead superset. 
Thick bar on chin-ups, hand grip didn't have it - also going to be harder after the curls naturally.
Shoulder pain on dips hence low rep count, probably had the strength to do 15-18. Overall this is a pretty good arm touch up... maybe stretch the arm superset to 3 sets and add in a db press?
Back pain. This is a pitiful run but it's going to take a few weeks for the back to tolerate this - keep getting your step counts high and running as much as you can

No bike - lots of steps.
Chin-ups were hard - but varied grip and did OHP first. 
Seated rows, went for strong form instead of weight - no lat pull down was available and the gym was very crowded. Still not there stamina wise or power wise but the strength is mostly there.

Need WD-40 for bike... got lots of steps. Hips were really tight so I stopped a few things a bit early - did 3 sets of tire flips as well (heavier one outside) - core is decently sore - Also did some leg lifts on the vertical mount

Had to cut short - not a lot of time today. Squats were as deep as I could go and with short breaks - could probably do heavier in a longer session with more stretching and warm ups. Same goes for speed trap bars, I did all sets on the start of the minute and executed well. Hips and back still sore for sure - stretch more

Back pain still preventing accessory run since I need to save it for tempo run tomorrow - Added more chest volume since I'm not benching as much now. Shoulders hurt on dips previously so good exercise to replace.
Back pain bad - got to 18,500 steps - these need to be 20,000 step days until you can run better

Strong, hard session. 10/10 effort logged on watch. This is well-designed workout, but tough on the back with the running but that strength will come.
WD-40 came in for bike and I will start to log these as well

Skull crushers felt easy relative to curls.
Push up form felt better.
Was taking short rests since the gym was crowded and I was occupying a bench - could probably do a little more weight all around with longer rests. 
Chin-Ups were full lock out with rest after the arm work. Feel good about being able to do 20.
Back pain is going to make me skip the run here to gear up for the marathon builder instead.
Planning for a moderate bike ride later in the night
Tried to run slower to help with the back pain - did not help - so picked pace back up - two breaks to egt the mile done

Work gym - Barbell Rows - Preacher EZ Curls - shitty lat pull down machine (forced grip path) - DB Bench felt awesome and OHP felt awesome - was on the heavy side today so not surprising that chin-ups were a bit weak and the weight moving was strong.
Workout seems short but the core definitely gets worked and you should feel better at the end of this

Tough leg day. Worked hard. Squats were full depth every time. Lunges - bulgarian barbell. Done at work gym - maxed out leg extension I'm not confident on the number - played softball that night and felt alright moving around - very sore the next day
Had to rush a bit to make it home on time - could probably do a bit more weight after the power waevs with a bit more rest
Skipped
Leg strength is definitely coming back pretty quickly - that MU trap bar is ass but the squat and bulgarians feel strong and so do the curls
Pec Deck was taken the whole time - I skipped a little more than I meant to here... Arms and shoulders were very tight and sore - good workout. 60s were tough to curl.

Bike HR consistently at 140+ - hard work @ 13500 meter / half hour clip. 
Groin still too tight for bosu ball work - can feel the pull on sit-ups even so kept it easy for run + softball tomorrow. 
Good day for the sauna. Ramp up nutrition for Wave 3
Got 21.7k steps and played softball as well. No breaks on the mile!

Hit chin on third set of Overhead Press. Bit heavy. Light sleep and not a lot of protein last few days. Used plate loaded machines for rows and lat pulls at MU and thick bar for chin-ups. Arms very sore. New bike still not in.
Pre-emptively filling out to view Wave 3 of squat day - going to do both of these today
Doing core day and squat day in one - so no run but long bike!
No bench available - used DBs
On treadmill
SoHamstring curl machine at work gym is heavier than at MU
Softball afterwards
No run - softball and 21k steps
Great Squats! Starting squat day at 2 plates instead of 1 makes the barbell on the back feel lighter - even if it's just a placebo effect!
Accessories might be a bit inaccurate - max 295 for sure.
Lots of steps
Almost got the 613
